descriptions.zh:
似乎作为我们不仅同[From.GetName]停滞圣权开战，更是随后接受了战败这一事实的惩罚，和平谈判结束之后，[From.GetAdj]特工出现在了[Root.GetRulerTitle][rulername.GetName]身旁。

他们用闻所未闻的武器处决了我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。行凶后他们就消失在虚空之中，就好像从未出现过一样。
descriptions.en:
As if to punish us for not only warring with the Stagnant Ascendancy of the [From.GetName] but for then accepting defeat, [From.GetAdj] agents appeared by [Root.GetRulerTitle] [rulername.GetName]'s side after the peace negotiations concluded.

They dispatched our [Root.GetRulerTitle] with unseen weaponry and practiced brutality before melting away as if they were never there.

label.zh: 我们战败了，我们被羞辱了，但是我们还会东山再起的。
label.en: We are defeated and humiliated, but will rise again.

descriptions.zh: 傲慢的虫子啊！你们认为[Root.GetSpeciesName]玷污者我们圣地的殖民者能够不被注意到吗？立即离开我们的星球或者面对我们舰队的力量吧！
descriptions.en: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
label.en: We have no choice but to accept...

tooltips.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!会勃然大怒，很可能会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们发现你们正在笨拙地尝试创造人工智能，认为你们正在走上灵魂自毁的错误道路上。立即停止这个愚蠢的举动，否则我们会帮你停止。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
label.en: We have no choice but to accept...

tooltips.zh: §H人工智能§!政策将被改为§H非法§!。
tooltips.en: §HArtificial Intelligence§! policy will be set to §HOutlawed§!.

tooltips.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!会勃然大怒，很可能会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesName]野蛮人！别以为没人发现你们的暴行。你们肆意的屠杀和奴役行径正在威胁整个星系的未来。我们给你个选择的机会：停止你野蛮的行径，否则就做好准备面对我们的正义制裁吧。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
label.en: We have no choice but to accept...

§H奴隶制§!政策将被改为§H禁止§!。
§H净化§!政策将改为§H禁止§!。

§HSlavery§! policy will be set to §HProhibited§!.
§HPurge§! policy will be set to §HProhibited§!.

tooltips.en: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

descriptions.zh: 顽固的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！这是对你们冒犯我们领地的最后一次警告！马上撤走，不然我们会替宇宙清除污秽——也就是你们这悲哀渺小的物种。
descriptions.en: Filthy [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! You have encroached upon our space for the last time! Withdraw immediately, or we will cleanse the stain upon the universe that is your worthless species.

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
label.en: We have no choice but to accept...

tooltips.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!会勃然大怒，很可能会攻击我们。
tooltips.en: §H[From.GetName]§! will be very angry, and are likely to attack us.

descriptions.zh: 无知的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们对长者的不敬简直大错特错。匍匐在我们面前乞求宽恕，我们或许有可能放过你们那毫无价值的小帝国。
descriptions.en: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.

descriptions.zh: 不和谐的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。难道你们没有发现自己是在带来杂音逼我们动手吗。好自为之，不然我们会来帮你们调调音准的。
descriptions.en: Disharmonious [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Don't you see that by inviting chaos you force us to intervene. Harmonize now or we will tune you.

descriptions.zh: 愚昧的[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们拒绝成长演化就是对生命本身的亵渎。乖乖听话，否则我们会把你们连根拔起，反正我们再种下新的种子亦非难事。
descriptions.en: Stagnant [Root.GetSpeciesName], your refusal to grow and evolve is an affront to life itself. Embrace our teachings, or we will uproot your failure and sow the seeds of progress ourselves

descriptions.zh: 怯懦的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的帝国就是脆弱的教科书。把你们的弱点咽下去，好好道歉，然后准备接受我们的挑战——否则我们可以随手把你们化为齑粉，用更有价值的人来替代你们。
descriptions.en: Cowardly [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your empire is a testament to frailty. Now swallow your weakness, apologize, and get ready to meet our challenge - or we will shatter you and replace you with someone more worthy.

label.zh: 我们别无选择，只能接受……
label.en: We have no choice but to accept...

descriptions.zh:
我们并不是[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]的第一位访客。这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球上所蕴含的待开发资源已经足以引人注目，而我们更是发现了一座停泊于高层轨道的古老且装饰华丽的信标。[from.GetName]显然属于某个远古的太空文明，但我们尚未发现他们在此处有任何的定居或勘探的迹象。

可能的理论有很多，但证据迫使我们考虑存在这么一个古老的文明，崇敬着这个郁郁葱葱的星球。我们只能猜测他们目前的下落——也就是说，假设他们仍然存在。
descriptions.en:
We are not the first to visit [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. This [from.GetClassAdj] world is remarkable enough for its abundance of untouched resources, but we also found an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy perched in high orbit. [from.GetName] was clearly known to some ancient, spacefaring civilization, but we can find no evidence that they settled or even prospected here.

Theories abound, but evidence compels us to consider an ancient civilization which once revered this lush world. We can only guess as to their current whereabouts - that is, assuming they still exist.

descriptions.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中，[from.GetName]有过神圣触碰的痕迹。我们位于[root.GetName]上的研究人员表示这个地方充满着深深的崇敬感，在高轨道上发现的一座古老的、装饰华丽的标记信标更加印证了这一说法。

我们相信[from.GetName]曾一度被视为圣体或者圣地而得到崇拜。至于是谁，我们尚且不知道——我们最好的猜测是，他们是一个已经衰落的唯心主义文明。
descriptions.en:
There is a touch of the Divine about [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Our researchers aboard the [root.GetName] suggest an aura of deep reverence about this place, backed by their discovery of an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy in high orbit.

We believe [from.GetName] may once have been worshipped as a deity, or else it was considered a holy place. To whom, we do not yet know - but our best theories suggest a spiritually-minded civilization which has since fallen into decline.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的这颗郁郁葱葱的行星[from.GetName]进行了调查，结果表明，它曾经是另一种未知生命形式非常感兴趣的对象。我们在高轨道上发现了一个古老的导航信标，这表明，这颗行星曾有过外星访客，但在过去的几个世纪里，没有任何登陆或殖民的证据。相反，似乎有什么东西可以在保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球——但就目前情况而言，对于这样一个假定的实体，其命运和下落我们依旧不得而知。
descriptions.en: Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to some other, as yet unknown, life-form. An ancient navigation buoy in high orbit implies the planet has seen alien visitors, but there is no evidence of landfall or colonization in the past few centuries. Instead something seems to have preserved this [from.GetClassAdj] world - but the current fate or whereabouts of such a hypothetical entity are as yet unknown to us.

descriptions.zh:
我们怀疑，对于[from.GetName]而言，还存在比丰富的资源和原始的自然环境更重要的东西。奇怪的是，[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系里的这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一座古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。这台装置的外壳上蚀刻着复杂的图案，虽然还不是非常肯定，但我们相信这种美术形式应该源自附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。

他们对我们的态度相当捉摸不透，所以我们只能猜测[spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj]对这颗星球有何规划。至少没有迹象表明我们对[from.GetName]的兴趣冒犯到了他们……
descriptions.en:
We suspect there is more to [from.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [from.GetClassAdj] world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system lies curiously untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit. Intricate designs have been etched into the hull of this device, and though we cannot say with certainty: we believe the origins of this artistry lie with the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName].

So inscrutable is their attitude towards us, we can only speculate upon [spi_fallen_empire.GetAdj] designs for this world. There is at least no indication yet that our interest in [from.GetName] has caused them any offense...

descriptions.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中，[from.GetName]有过神圣触碰的痕迹。我们位于[root.GetName]上的研究人员表示这个地方充满着深深的崇敬感，在高轨道上发现的一座古老的、装饰华丽的标记信标更加印证了这一说法。

我们相信[from.GetName]被视为圣体而崇拜，或者说是被视为圣地一般。信标的装饰风格暗示，可能就是[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]在崇拜这个地方。不清楚现在是否还是如此。
descriptions.en:
There is a touch of the Divine about [from.GetName], in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. Our researchers aboard the [root.GetName] suggest an aura of deep reverence about this place, backed by their discovery of an ancient and richly-decorated marker buoy in high orbit.

We believe [from.GetName] was worshipped as a deity, or else has been regarded as a holy place. The decorative styling on the buoy suggests it may even be the [spi_fallen_empire.GetName] who once revered this place. It is unclear whether or not that is still the case.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[from.GetName]的调查表明，这颗位于[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系中的丰饶行星曾经是一个先进——但多愁善感的——生命形式所热衷的对象。其高轨道上有一个停用已久的导航信标，蚀刻着一些与§H[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]§!文化相似的设计纹路。

似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曾经发誓要保护这颗[from.GetClassAdj]星球，但至于现在是否仍是如此我们不得而知。
descriptions.en:
Our survey of [from.GetName] suggests this bountiful world in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system was once a subject of keen interest to an advanced - though sentimental - life-form. A long-disused navigation buoy in high orbit has been etched with intricate designs similar to those displayed by the §H[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]§!.

It seems the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] once sought to preserve this [from.GetClassAdj] world, though they give no indication if that is still the case.

label.zh: 我们也应该崇敬这个地方。
label.en: We shall honor this place also.
It is ours for the taking.

label.zh: 我们可以在此发展繁荣。
